title: Impossible to negate a value with connectToggleFilter
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When we are using connectToggleFilter, the `on/off `values are escaped so we can not pass minus sign to invoke a negation filtering.
For example, my value is '-0' because I want all results that do not match facet value '0'.

See : https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/f802fd0f56d7e898c85e947fa6a3e5c11ff1b6ec/packages/instantsearch.js/src/connectors/toggle-refinement/connectToggleRefinement.ts#L194

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Go on the codesandbox
2. Click on the "Brand" Toggle
3. Nothing is displayed

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/s/weathered-meadow-9yw8p7?file=/src/App.tsx

### 💭 Expected behavior

All brand are displayed except 'Apple'

### Package version

react-instantsearch-hooks-web 6.32.0

### Operating system

Windows 10

### Browser

Chrome 110

### Code of Conduct

- [X] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

comments.body:
Hi @AntoineDuComptoirDesPharmacies,

The values passed in `on` do need to be escaped for them to work properly with other widgets such as `CurrentRefinements`.

One way to apply negative filters would be to use `Configure` with `NOT brand:Apple` in `filters`.

Alternatively you could create your own connector and use the [`toggleFacetExclusion`](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/reference.html#AlgoliaSearchHelper%23toggleFacetExclusion) method from the helper.

Hi @aymeric-giraudet
I understand your point of view. Maybe this escape feature could be configurable (opt-in or opt-out) to avoid duplicating the connectToggleFilter code ?

As for the `Configure` solution we tried it but we encounter the following behavior.
Imagine a page with a toggleRefinement where `on` value is '5'.
Off value is not set because negative filter is not possible, so we instantiate a `Configure` node that take the negative filter in properties when `isRefined = false`.

1. User arrive on the page, checkbox is not checked, query is sent with negative filter from `Configure`
2. User check the box, toggleRefinement `refine` is executed but `Configure` will only dismount on next rerender.
So, query is sent with both `on` and `off` value.
3. Configure node is dismounted from the DOM, another query is sent with `on` value only

This result is two query sent when checkbox is checked, instead of one.
